subject: storytime
title: Frog and Toad words
about: Frog and Toad are two best friends who share five little stories: a spring wake-up, a lost button, a swim, a story and a letter in the mail. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the stories, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read one of the five stories together each night.

book.author: Arnold Lobel
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: Five small, warm stories about two friends who look after each other.

passage.text:

wake hop button pocket

cards.note: capital F, it is his name; f-r blend
capital T, it is his name; oa says long o, like boat
s-p-r blend; ng is one sound
magic e: the e makes a say its name
tt is one t; two parts: but + ton, the o says u: but-un
two parts: pock + et; ck is one sound
two parts: jack + et; ck is one sound
tt is one t; two parts: let + ter; er says er
s-n blend, then ai says long a
ie says e; the s says z: frendz
the ai says e here, not long a: sed
